title: Cruise Outbreaks Rose As Ships Packed In Thousands
hook: One virus keeps finding cruise ships packed with thousands of passengers.
closing: Crowded cruises give contagious illness thousands of chances to spread.
question: Would outbreaks change your cruise pick?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, continuing a three-year rise.
Norovirus caused 15 cruise outbreaks, making one illness the main driver.
Some cruise ships carry 7,600 guests, giving norovirus a huge crowd of close contacts.
